== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Aurelian Empire]] is a civilization established approximately fifteen hundred years ago following the defeat of the [[Great Elders]]. It was founded to bring stability to a world previously thrown into chaos by those ancient beings. [[The Empire]]'s capital is a massive, bustling city that houses the Emperor's palace, which occupies a significant portion of the urban area. While the Emperor serves as a central symbol of civilization and stability, his long life is tied to a [[Great Elder]], making him an immortal figure who can monitor the world through a specialized [[throne]] and global receptor network. The structure of [[The Empire|the Empire]] relies heavily on various [[Guilds]], which act as its foundational pillars, and a group of [[Regents]] who can serve as warriors against Elder threats. However, [[The Empire|the Empire]] faces internal instability; following the death of an Emperor, leadership may shift to [[Regents]], creating potential vulnerabilities if they become corrupted. [[The Empire]]'s survival is a constant struggle against the [[Great Elders]], who seek to destroy human civilization and reclaim the world. To combat this, humanity utilizes specialized abilities such as [[Reading]], the creation of [[Soulbound]], and the application of [[Intent]]. Despite its strengths, [[The Empire|the Empire]] faces ongoing threats from Elder-related phenomena like [[Elderspawn]] and the long-term machinations of timeless entities like [[Ach'magut]].}}

== Of Darkness and Dawn ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[The Empire]] is a political entity that includes the town of [[Silverreach]] and operates under the influence of the Emperor. Although it functions as an organization that the [[Consultants]] might potentially join, [[The Empire|the Empire]] is currently weakening and has begun to collapse in on itself. This state of instability has led the [[Great Elders]] to seek its total [[destruction]].}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">6</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The Emperor has an influence on [[The Empire|the Empire]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c4">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 4</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[The Empire]] is a political entity containing the town of [[Silverreach]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c7">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 7</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[The Empire]] is described as weak and having collapsed in on itself.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c19">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 19</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The [[Great Elders]] want to destroy [[The Empire|the Empire]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c21">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 21</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[The Empire]] is weakening.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c22">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 22</ref>}}</li>

</ul></div>

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|said. “We’ve already divided into regions, under the four Regents.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c17" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|“The Empire is weakening,” he said, walking the border between passion and insubordinate anger.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c22" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|“Haven’t I served the Empire all this time?”<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c13" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|“From the beginning, I was willing to go to prison to serve the Empire,” Lucan said.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c21" />}}
